status: Fictional demo accounts for the six workbook reference employees plus staff accounts. Mapping only: names and payroll values are read from the workbook at seed time; no ID numbers, salaries or credentials are stored in this file.
currentArrangementSource: The workbook column 'רכב היום' gives only a commercial name (or an allowance note). A commercial name alone never selects a vehicle, so each employee's current vehicle is mapped explicitly here; the seed fails unless the mapped catalogue vehicle's commercial name equals the workbook text exactly. Same mapping as tests/unit/business/bl/test_reference_employees.py.
